newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-LAMA SAID CLOSE TO SIGNING FOR REAL MADRID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LAMA SAID CLOSE TO SIGNING FOR REAL MADRID.

text.p: Paris St Germain's French international goalkeeper Bernard Lama is due in Madrid this week to try and reach an agreement with Real Madrid, sources close to the player said on Monday.
Lama has another year to run on his contract with PSG but the Parisian club have agreed to his move abroad and have played Christophe Revault, signed from Le Havre in the off-season, in goal.

While PSG are away in Bucharest for their European Cup preliminary round first leg against Steaua, Lama hopes to meet with Real president Lorenzo Sanz and make a deal before the August 15 deadline for Champions' League registrations.

The sources said PSG and Real have already settled on a transfer fee of around eight million francs ($1.5 million) for the 33-year-old goalkeeper whom coach Jupp Heynckes is said to be keen to have in his squad.
